Incumbent builds, implements and maintains the LIS system within the Epic electronic health record. Manages complex Information System projects/products in order to provide solutions that meet UCI Health System's business needs using the Epic solution. The incumbent provides support for all computer and information systems activities of the Laboratory Department. Maintains Epic applications by facilitating updates, new releases and system enhancements along with issue troubleshooting and resolution. Communicates project and team status to internal and external audiences and participates in system technical and application reviews to determine feasibility, cost and evaluate usefulness for UCI Health System. Assists in recruitment, development and training of existing and new employees.
Must be willing to participate in 24 hour on-call rotations as a system duty officer

Working knowledge of operations, systems and functions, including planning, design, development, implementation, user support and training, maintenance, quality assurance, and system testing and evaluation.
Knowledge of University and Medical Center organizations, policies, procedures and forms
Strong written and verbal communication skills
Knowledge of LIS maintenance, including new test builds
Recent and in-depth knowledge of LIS function and usage

Must demonstrate customer service skills appropriate to the job
General knowledge and familiarity with theory and practice of laboratory medicine
Excellent organizational and planning skills and ability to manage multiple activities and varied deadlines at one time
Demonstrated skill to work independently and to prioritize and manage a relative number of simultaneous requests and to work on tasks which may not be clearly defined
Ability to maintain a work pace appropriate to the workload
Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships across the Health System
Ability to apply logical troubleshooting and analysis techniques for the purpose of problem resolution
